summary: Ericsson files Form 6-K announcing weekly share repurchases under its SEK 15 billion buyback program running April 23 2026 to March 31 2027. During April 20-24 2026 it repurchased 2.4 million Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 105.69 totaling approximately SEK 253.7 million. The board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM excluding those for incentive plans. Acquisitions are executed on Nasdaq Stockholm via Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE under MAR Safe Harbour. Treasury stock now stands at 40,402,276 Class B shares out of 3,371,351,735 total shares. This is a routine share buyback disclosure not an event-driven special situation.
